newsitem.title: EGYPT: National Bank of Egypt's year-end profit rises.
newsitem.headline: National Bank of Egypt's year-end profit rises.

text.p: The National Bank of Egypt, the main state-owned retail bank, said it increased its distributable profits in the financial year 1995/96 by 30 percent to 130 million pounds ($38.24 million) on the previous year. The financial year ends on June 30.
Customers' deposits rose to 39,194 million from 35,281 million in 94/95.
The bank's total assets on June 30, 1996, also rose to 86,363 million from 77,235 million one year earlier.
Shareholders' funds went up slightly to 1.851 million pounds at the end of 1995/96 from 1.732 million at the end of 1994/5.
